_meta.what: Written copy for the generated program pages, keyed by program slug. Facts (dates, times, prices, ages, options, skills) come from data/programs.json and never from here.
_meta.rule: A key that is missing leaves its section or line out of the page. Nothing is filled in. Strings are HTML.
_meta.skills: Descriptions are keyed by the skill name exactly as it appears in the program's teaches list. A skill with no description shows its name only.
_meta.image: The hero image is an asset choice, not copy. The five programs without copy use the photo their homepage or camps card already uses.
_meta.tokens: Copy may use tokens filled from the data at build time, so a count or a month can never drift from the schedule: {sessions} {home} {away} (counts as words, {Home} capitalised), {away_months}, {day}, {Day}, {home_time}, {away_time}. Venue session counts are generated, never written.

faq: What if we miss a Saturday?
Sessions can’t be carried over, but tell us ahead and Lou will catch the player up.
Does my player need their own gear?
Bring a glove. We supply bats, helmets and the rest. Turf shoes or sneakers, no metal cleats.
Yes. The infield work is the same and the groups train side by side.
Yes, there’s seating along the netting. We ask that the coaching stays with Lou.
What if it is full when we try?
Call us and we’ll tell you if a place opens.
